finding: crisis3y uses t,t+1,t+2; partial terminal horizons left at zero unless an observed crisis occurs. This differs from strict future t+1..t+3.
consequence: Report both conventions; omit censored terminal records for prospective labels.

finding: Monthly threshold tuned to 4% annual crisis frequency; gen_non_clustered_crisis condition is index-crisis_last<0*12.
consequence: Frequency is a definition/calibration choice; code does not enforce advertised 3-year non-consecutive crises.

finding: credit_growth_past_year uses lag 12 on annual table; GDP/credit forward-growth tails are padded zeros.
consequence: Variable name is misleading (12 years); omit undefined tails for new calculations.

finding: Regression uses before_crises (one-year-before); output note says five-year-before.
consequence: Reconcile model code/label and separately estimate a stated prospective five-year definition.

finding: Source computes 3-period window including t while table heading/footnote says next five years; froth is current spread below full-path median.
consequence: Distinguish replication from prospective warning validation and retrospective threshold estimation.

finding: Empirical comparator coefficients are assigned constants to model regression objects (e.g.18.0/2.8). No underlying empirical estimation sample in these objects.
consequence: May cite author/literature comparator; cannot label independently reproduced real-data regressions.

finding: Statistical credit spread is divided by full-path SD; policy-state routines divide equilibrium spread by simulated mean.
consequence: Policy target cs=1 denotes mean-normalized spread, not one SD or 1% spread.

finding: Intervention changes w to 1.1*w; deterministic branch bank_credit_impulse uses ratio of xK (leverage), not full bank credit balance.
consequence: Do not describe this variable as realized credit growth or a capital-ratio regulation effect without reconciling definition.

finding: Match leverage and mean-normalized spreads first; solve nonlinear w/believed lambda; diagnostic case maps believed lambda back to underlying with reference and lag parameters. Residual/bounds checked in author code.
consequence: Same observed leverage/spread does not imply same w, beliefs or underlying state; changing theta at fixed state is not comparable policy evidence.

finding: Serialized core grids contain p/kappap/credit_spread/par but not full post-processed leverage grids or counterfactual trajectories.
consequence: Source review supports policy mechanism audit; current independent reference does not reproduce equilibrium/recapitalization paths.

finding: capital_excess_return_normalized scales by its sample mean to 0.059; table note describes matching standard deviation.
consequence: Audit implementation separately from economic comparability; cannot infer a matched return volatility solely from the note.
